title: Zak settings
description: Zak's settings file (config.json in Zak's profile folder; Settings → Customize → Open the settings file). Zak applies changes as soon as the file is saved. Unknown or invalid values fall back to their default.

language.description: Interface language; applied at the next launch.

startup.description: Reopen the last session's tabs, or start on a new tab.

theme.description: Zak's own look (tab strip, sidebar, internal pages).

sitesTheme.description: Light or dark mode web pages see (prefers-color-scheme); system = the computer's, whatever Zak's theme.

downloadDir.description: Absolute path of the downloads folder. Defaults to the system's Downloads folder.

askWhereToSave.description: Ask where to save each download instead of saving it straight into downloadDir.

safeBrowsing.description: Warn before opening known phishing or malware pages.

savePasswords.description: Offer to save passwords after a sign-in.

sleepTabsAfter.description: Minutes before a background tab is unloaded; 0 = never.

newtabHeadlines.description: What may show under the new tab page logo, one picked at random for each tab: Zak's words, newtabTitle/newtabSubtitle, a quote, a proverb, on this day in history or a random article (Wikipedia, in Zak's language). Empty: nothing.

pip.description: Automatic picture-in-picture when leaving a tab that plays a video.

autoplayed.description: Also videos a page starts by itself (feeds). By default, only videos the user started (a click or a key press) go to picture-in-picture.

excludedDomains.description: Domains (subdomains included) where it never triggers, e.g. "youtube.com".

style.description: zak: Zak's own floating window (rounded corners, Zak's buttons, the tab moved into it); system: Chromium's Picture-in-Picture.

side.description: Which side of the page the sidebar sits on.

tabs.description: Tabs in the strip at the top of the window, or one per row in the sidebar (under the folders).

appearance.description: Zak's own colors and fonts (zak://appearance, MCP update_appearance): only what differs from Zak's defaults. Applied at once, over a mod theme; private windows keep their colors.

colors.description: Color tokens per theme. frame = tab strip and sidebar, cream = toolbar and Zak's pages, iris and pink = accents.

fonts.description: An installed font family, or null for Zak's own (DM Sans, Fraunces, JetBrains Mono).

mono.description: The address in the address bar, code.

extensionBar.description: Extension icons shown at the top of the sidebar, Zak tools included (ids zak:screenshot, zak:translate). An extension or tool without an icon keeps working.

order.description: Extension or tool ids, left to right.

hidden.description: Extension or tool ids whose icon stays out of the sidebar.

unpackedExtensions.description: Absolute paths of folders loaded as unpacked Chrome extensions (each with a manifest.json). Zak reloads them when their files change.

tools.description: Zak's own tools, on zak://extensions (Zak tools). A tool switched off leaves no menu item or button.

translate.description: Right-click on a selection: translated in place in a field one types in, in a bubble elsewhere. Text goes to Google Translate only on that click.

target.description: Language a text one reads is translated into (a Google Translate code such as "en" or "zh-CN"); empty = Zak's language.

recent.description: Languages last chosen in « Translate into », most recent first.

screenshot.description: Screenshots of a page (File menu, Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+2, or the page's right-click menu): an area drawn, the visible page or the full page, copied to the clipboard and saved in the downloads folder.

record.description: Screen recording, like Loom (File menu, Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+E, the page's right-click menu or its sidebar icon): a screen or a window, the camera in a round bubble, the microphone; a video saved in the downloads folder.

cameraLabel.description: Camera chosen, by its name; empty = the system's.

micLabel.description: Microphone chosen, by its name; empty = the system's.

colors.description: Colors: an eyedropper anywhere on the screen (Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+K, its sidebar icon), and the brand kit of the open site (palette icon, File menu, right-click). History, favorites and brand kits (in folders, with a comment) on zak://colors.

format.description: How a picked color is copied.

onboarded.description: The welcome page has been shown.
